command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_SHA=ffa1d0b48bfade144a77be208b0d76af2ecaecc841999eb58e1a3263dac3173a
[ "$(sha256sum omega_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_SHA" ] || { echo SOURCE_DRIFT; exit 42; }
TASK_COUNT=$(sqlite3 state/omega.sqlite3 "select count(*) from task where state in ('OPEN','DISPATCHED');")
[ "$TASK_COUNT" = "0" ] || { echo "NONTERMINAL_TASKS=$TASK_COUNT"; exit 43; }
OLDPID=$(pgrep -f '^python3 /workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py$' | head -1)
[ -n "$OLDPID" ] || { echo NO_OLD_DAEMON; exit 44; }
echo OLDPID=$OLDPID
tmux send-keys -t omega-grid C-c
for i in $(seq 1 30); do if ! kill -0 "$OLDPID" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 0.2; done
if kill -0 "$OLDPID" 2>/dev/null; then echo OLD_DAEMON_STILL_RUNNING; exit 45; fi
for i in $(seq 1 20); do if ! tmux has-session -t omega-grid 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 0.1; done
if tmux has-session -t omega-grid 2>/dev/null; then echo OLD_TMUX_STILL_PRESENT; exit 46; fi
tmux new-session -d -s omega-grid "python3 /workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py >>/workspace/omega_runtime/omega-grid.log 2>&1"
sleep 1
NEWPID=$(pgrep -f '^python3 /workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py$' | head -1)
[ -n "$NEWPID" ] || { echo NEW_DAEMON_MISSING; exit 47; }
echo NEWPID=$NEWPID
echo SHA=$(sha256sum omega_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')
echo STATUS
cat state/STATUS.json 2>/dev/null || true
